content: Neomycin sulfate oral preparations must not be administered to patients who have an intestinal obstruction. The use of neomycin sulfate is contraindicated in individuals with a known history of hypersensitivity to this drug. Patients who have previously experienced hypersensitivity reactions or severe toxic effects from other aminoglycoside antibiotics may exhibit cross-sensitivity to neomycin and should not receive this medication. Neomycin sulfate oral solution is contraindicated in patients with inflammatory or ulcerative gastrointestinal conditions, as these conditions may increase the absorption of neomycin from the gastrointestinal tract, potentially leading to systemic toxicity.
